title: Fix SQL injection vulnerability in controller sort parameters
description:
All controller index actions use unsanitized params[:sort] directly in .order() calls, allowing arbitrary SQL injection.

Example (ProductsController:17, NichesController:14, etc.):
  products.order(params[:sort] || 'created_at DESC')

An attacker can inject SQL: ?sort=id);DROP TABLE products;--
acceptance_criteria:
- Implement whitelist of allowed sort columns per controller
- Sanitize sort direction (asc/desc only)
- Return 400 Bad Request for invalid sort parameters
- Add tests for SQL injection attempts

title: Add error handling for ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound in controllers
description:
Controllers use before_action :set_resource methods that call Model.find(params[:id]), but there's no rescue_from for ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound.

When a user requests a non-existent ID, Rails returns a 500 error instead of 404.

Example: GET /api/v1/products/99999
Expected: 404 Not Found
Actual: 500 Internal Server Error
acceptance_criteria:
- Add rescue_from ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound in BaseController
- Return proper 404 JSON response: { error: 'Resource not found' }
- Add tests for 404 responses on all show/update/destroy actions
- Verify error handling across all 6 controllers

title: Fix double count query in pagination helper
description:
BaseController#paginate calls collection.count twice (lines 27 and 30), causing redundant database queries.

Current code:
  total: collection.count,  # line 27
  ...
  total_pages: (collection.count.to_f / per_page).ceil  # line 30

This doubles database load on every paginated request.
acceptance_criteria:
- Cache collection.count in a variable
- Use cached value for both total and total_pages
- Add test to verify only one COUNT query is executed
- Verify performance improvement with query log

title: Add validation for belongs_to relationships in models
description:
Models have belongs_to associations but no validation that the foreign key exists.

Examples:
- Product belongs_to :design (no design_id validation)
- Niche belongs_to :trend_signal (no trend_signal_id validation)
- CulturalToken belongs_to :niche (no niche_id validation)

This can lead to orphaned records.
acceptance_criteria:
- Add validates :design_id, presence: true to Product
- Add validates :trend_signal_id, presence: true to Niche
- Add validates :niche_id, presence: true to CulturalToken
- Add similar validations to all other belongs_to associations
- Add tests for validation failures

title: Replace weak default API key with secure authentication
description:
BaseController uses a weak default API key 'dev-api-key-change-in-production' (line 13). This is a security vulnerability.

Current code:
  unless api_key == ENV.fetch('API_KEY', 'dev-api-key-change-in-production')

The default value makes the API vulnerable if ENV['API_KEY'] is not set.
acceptance_criteria:
- Remove default value from ENV.fetch('API_KEY')
- Fail hard if API_KEY is not set (raise error on boot)
- Document API key setup in backend/README.md
- Add test for missing API_KEY scenario
